patch.summary: Lusha migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Lusha by inventorying legacy sales-intelligence fields, mapping them to Lusha objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.
Success signal: prospecting works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Lusha migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power prospecting, data enrichment, contact management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Lusha; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Salesforce; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SDR/BDR teams needing verified emails/dials and enrichment outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.
If Lusha mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Apollo.io before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Salesforce in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: API access and some connectors are plan-gated (Pro+ / Scale nuances documented).

checklist.label: Mitigate: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
